representation_fit.evidence: Node-link dependency graph with 33 nodes/58 edges across 6 lanes (screenshots/1280x860.png; source/data.js:7-61) directly matches the brief's relational-web shape (many, high relationality, medium hierarchy); relationships are first-class: edges are clickable with dedicated edge cards (source/app.js:313-341), matching object_type=relationship.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Initial screen is ~75% relationship graph; header tagline '理解关系结构：依赖与影响，可跟随、不丢失全局' (source/index.html:17); mode group 相邻/依赖闭包/影响闭包 overlaid on stage (source/index.html:40-44); overview panel leads with stats, hubs and P0 关键链路 (screenshot 1280x860, right panel; source/app.js:262-282).

time_to_understand.evidence: What/where conveyed at a glance: lane labels with counts top of canvas, legend for the 3 edge types + P0/P1/P2 bottom-left, persistent stats '33 节点 · 58 关系 · 6 层' in topbar (screenshots/1280x860.png and 1440x900.png; source/index.html:52-59), and a '怎么用' instruction block in the initial panel (source/app.js:282).

navigation_cost.evidence: Primary object (relationship) reachable in one click with no mode switch: P0 关键链路 buttons in initial panel (source/app.js:256-261), direct edge-hit click on SVG (source/app.js:388-390), hub node rows (source/app.js:276-278), plus search jump (source/app.js:425-445). No navigation/menus between screens; single main screen per brief.

context_loss.evidence: Seed-critical design: full graph always rendered; focus only dims to opacity 0.13 and never hides (source/app.js:2-4; source/styles.css:138,160-163); following accumulates a breadcrumb tracebar with click-to-return-to-step (source/app.js:189-223); edge selection preserves the follow path (source/app.js:372,391); deep-link hash syncs path+mode (source/app.js:502-527).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are minimal and each maps to the job: topbar (search/stats/reset, index.html:20-25), 3 highlight-mode buttons (index.html:40-44), 3 zoom controls (index.html:46-50), legend (index.html:52-59), context panel (index.html:64-66). Tracebar/tooltip appear only on use (index.html:38,61). No redundant or decorative surfaces observed in either screenshot.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, type.min_projected_size=fail, only a11y.target_size=pass (measurement-summary.json checks). Positives: aria-label on search and svg role=img (source/index.html:21,30), :focus-visible outline (source/styles.css:41), text labels always accompany criticality colors (source/styles.css:21-27). Negatives: graph nodes/edges are non-focusable <g> click targets (source/app.js:94-106,81-91) explaining focus_order fail; low-contrast tokens --ink-3 #6b7a94 for lane labels/hints (source/styles.css:10,115-116) explaining contrast fail; 10px crit chips (source/styles.css:312) and 10px statrow labels (source/styles.css:291) consistent with min_projected_size fail.

frontend_rework.evidence: All three layout checks pass and target_invalid=false (measurement-summary.json: layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation). One visible defect in BOTH screenshots: a small stray empty pill at top-center of the canvas (~470,75 at 1280x860; ~550,74 at 1440x900) — the #tracebar, whose display:flex (source/styles.css:209-220) overrides the hidden attribute (source/index.html:38), rendering an empty breadcrumb shell on first load. Cosmetic, no evidence of rework-inducing errors.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '关系跟随不丢失全局上下文' is addressed structurally, not just rhetorically: dim-not-hide rule svg.has-focus (source/styles.css:161), follow accumulates only adjacent steps (source/app.js:352-359), breadcrumb retains prefix with per-step return (source/app.js:212), edge inspect keeps path (source/app.js:372), panel text restates the guarantee (source/app.js:282), and a browser selftest asserts '无任何节点被隐藏' via display!=none on all 33 nodes (source/selftest.js:52-58).

defects_observed: Stray empty tracebar pill visible at top-center of canvas in both 1280x860 and 1440x900 screenshots: .tracebar display:flex (source/styles.css:209-220) overrides the hidden attribute (source/index.html:38)
Receipt a11y.contrast=fail — consistent with low-contrast ink-3 #6b7a94 lane labels/hints (source/styles.css:10,115-116)
Receipt a11y.focus_order=fail — SVG nodes/edges are click-only non-focusable groups (source/app.js:94-106), keyboard users cannot traverse the graph
Receipt type.min_projected_size=fail — 10px crit chips (source/styles.css:312) and 10px statrow labels (source/styles.css:291)
scores.overall_note: A single-screen static dependency-graph browser whose representation matches the brief almost exactly: the relational web (33 nodes, 58 typed edges, 6 lanes) is the first and dominant surface, and the relationship itself — not just the node — is operable via clickable edges, edge cards with protocol/criticality metadata, and dependency/impact closure modes (source/app.js:142-155,313-341). The acceptance seed is implemented as an explicit invariant: focus dims non-related elements to opacity 0.13 without hiding them (styles.css:161), following accumulates a returnable breadcrumb, and inspecting an edge preserves the path, so global context survives every follow action. Navigation cost is one click from the initial screen via P0 key-link buttons, hub rows, canvas clicks, or search. The weaknesses are concentrated in accessibility, where the sanitized receipt records three of seven checks failing (contrast, focus order, min projected size) consistent with the source's non-focusable SVG interaction and dim gray label tokens; and one minor cosmetic defect, an empty breadcrumb pill visible at top-center on first load in both screenshots caused by display:flex overriding the hidden attribute. No layout, responsiveness, or truncation failures are recorded. Per the pilot protocol, task time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not judged here, and this model-judged review is not a substitute for a human study.
